text:
Maria (PM): quick check — post-launch followups: do we allocate a 20% bug-budget this sprint, or split 10% bug + 10% experiments? need a 1-line decision so eng can schedule.
Kevin (ENG): 20% bug-budget. ops simpler given the noise we've seen — p99 spikes and a couple of flaky regressions.
Anita (SRE): +1 for 20% for the next 2 sprints. also propose a small 'critical-bug buffer' not touched by experiments for security/regressions.
Sam (Design): FYI customer asked for a tiny UX polish that is a 1-day lift. if we go 20% i'd still like 1 quick slot for that.
Maria (PM): constraints: Dedicated rollout next Tue; SLA targets we must preserve: p99 latency, token-cost delta <5%, and recent customer NPS trend.
Kevin (ENG): with 20% bug-budget I can commit to triage within 24h and 72h fix SLAs for P0/P1. reduces context switching.
Kevin (ENG): ```
labels:
- bug-budget-sprint1
- critical-bug-buffer
- quick-ux-<=4h
```
Anita (SRE): canary gating suggestion: if p99 > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5% then auto-freeze experiments and prioritize rollback. I'll wire alerts.
Maria (PM): decision proposal: sprint = 20% bug budget + critical buffer (hold for security/regression). experiments allowed only if canary metrics are green. agree?
Kevin (ENG): +1
Sam (Design): +1 but with callout: allow the one-off quick polish if <=4h and doesn't touch inference path.
Anita (SRE): :thumbsup: I'll create the runbook and add the alert channels.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for release/1.4.2 — canary nodes 2/10. logs: https://internal/deploys/1699999999
Maria (PM): i'll update the sprint board and ping CS about expectation/SLAs. follow-ups: Kevin = top-5 bug candidates, Sam = mark quick UX asks.
Kevin (ENG): will add top-5 to backlog under bug-budget-sprint1, ETA EOD.
Sam (Design): tagged quickwins with "<=4h" and linked mocks to tickets.
Maria (PM): closing thread — hedge plan approved: 20% bug budget + critical buffer; experiments gated by canary. thanks all :rocket:
